introHtml: Custom 4XL shorts provide a comfortable fit for larger body types, ensuring your team or event staff feel at ease during long hours. Whether you choose moisture-wicking fabrics like the Men's Sport-Tek® Club 7” Short or classic cotton gym shorts, screen printing or embroidery keeps your logo visible. Durable construction and generous sizing make these shorts a practical choice for giveaways, uniform programs, or promotional events where inclusivity matters.
